_readme: Recall-probe candidates (COLLECTION.md s3), each with the source that raised it and its disposition. Collected from the register links, the Form D sweep, the firm's blog and site, TechCrunch and the exit-side EDGAR sweep, 2026-09-26.

candidates.name: zerolens GmbH
candidates.source: register: Fund V 'Beteiligung an: zerolens GmbH' (2022)
candidates.disposition: identity: zerolens GmbH (Vienna, FN 510990g) is the company behind Mokker.ai, on the list (Point Nine invested Sept 2020, nordic9.com); no new row

candidates.name: acardo group AG
candidates.source: register: Point Nine Co-Invest II on its shareholder list
candidates.disposition: reject: a shopper-activation agency founded 2000 (Dortmund, HRB 15280) that merged acardo activation GmbH in 2023 and filed eleven shareholder lists days later; a Fund II co-invest vehicle holding its shares reads as sale consideration for a Fund II company (COLLECTION.md s1), not a venture entry; on no Point Nine surface

candidates.name: Personio Group SE
candidates.disposition: reject: consideration for Back (acquired by Personio 2022, the site's own card); Back is the member

candidates.name: Lindentor 226. V V GmbH
candidates.source: register: Fund III and Co-Invest III shareholder lists 2025-06 to 2026-02
candidates.disposition: reject: Lindentor 226. V V GmbH (HRB 178914 B) is a Rocket Internet holding for food services (Rocket shareholder since 2019, the 'OH MY LUNCH' trademark 2020, HV Capital COCO Growth Fund 2023): Caterwings' holding, which bought Point Nine's Lemoncat in 2019 (the site's own card: 'acquired by Rocket Internet's Caterwings in 2019'); Fund III's and Co-Invest III's shares there are sale consideration for Lemoncat (COLLECTION.md s1), Lemoncat is the member

candidates.name: ePetWorld
candidates.source: TechCrunch 2013-02-13: an early Point Nine Capital II investment
candidates.disposition: identity check: probably Hundeland (the list's 2012 Munich pet-food shop, now part of AlphaPet Ventures)

candidates.name: trivago
candidates.source: Expedia 8-K 2012-12-21: 'Team Europe Ventures Limited' a selling shareholder
candidates.disposition: reject: the Team Europe incubator's Limited vehicle, not the fund KG; on no Point Nine list (D3)

candidates.name: OwnBackup
candidates.disposition: reject: Nicolas Wittenborn was a Point Nine Principal 2014-2016 and a Vice President at Insight Partners 2016-2018; the seat is Insight's (OwnBackup's July 2017 Series B was led by Insight), not Point Nine's; on no Point Nine surface (D10, T4 seat dating)

candidates.name: Numetric
candidates.disposition: reject: Nicolas Wittenborn was a Point Nine Principal 2014-2016 and a Vice President at Insight Partners 2016-2018; the seat is Insight's (OwnBackup's July 2017 Series B was led by Insight), not Point Nine's; on no Point Nine surface (D10, T4 seat dating)

candidates.name: Northlane
candidates.source: pointnine.com/love: co-founder at two Point Nine Founder Summits
candidates.disposition: reject: Northlane (northlane.partners) is a pricing-strategy consultancy that ran a session at the Point Nine Founder Summit ('extended Point Nine family'); no funding relationship on record, not an investment

candidates.name: Fundly, FinanceaCar
candidates.disposition: not rows unless a Point Nine surface lists them (D2)
